side_effects.authorization: Container metadata reads and explicitly authorized read-only HTTPS operations; website Set-Cookie may refresh the native session. Qianniu login submission requires explicit login intent for the selected container. Selected-target maintenance requires installation/update intent. Xiaohongshu page-mode search opens a temporary background tab in the selected container and reads visible search results. Explicit tab sleep/wake may release runtime state or reload in the original container; require exact tab, container and page-version preconditions. Explicit automatic-sleep configuration persists on the selected browser profile. A precisely targeted keep-running exception protects both automatic and manual sleep until tab close or browser restart.
